item.description: Missing SingleEndedPort and DifferentialPort classes in the IO module. Tests are failing with NameError: name 'SingleEndedPort' is not defined and NameError: name 'DifferentialPort' is not defined.
item.contract: Add SingleEndedPort and DifferentialPort classes to the amaranth/lib/io.py module. These classes should handle single-ended and differential I/O ports respectively, with proper validation of inputs and support for operations like slicing, concatenation, and inversion.

item.description: StructLayout and UnionLayout classes are not properly implementing the __int__ method for integer conversion, causing TypeError: 'StructLayout' object cannot be interpreted as an integer.
item.contract: Ensure StructLayout and UnionLayout classes properly implement the __int__ method that returns their size, consistent with the Layout base class implementation.

item.description: IOPort class is missing proper __hash__ method, causing TypeError: unhashable type: 'IOPort' when used in sets or as dictionary keys.
item.contract: Add a proper __hash__ method to the IOPort class to make it hashable. Also ensure the __eq__ method is correctly implemented for proper comparison.
